description: Java class implementing the service layer for task management, providing business logic such as CRUD operations for Task objects, with in-memory storage backed by ConcurrentHashMap.

classes.name: TaskService
classes.description: Service layer containing business logic for task management with in-memory storage.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns all tasks sorted by createdAt descending.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Returns a task by ID or throws NotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new task with given title, description, and due date.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates fields of an existing task identified by ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a task by ID or throws NotFoundException if not found.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description: Adds a batch of tasks, assigning IDs and timestamps where missing.
